title: Polynomial membership-query bound
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer, let $f$ be a sign-valued Boolean function on the $n$-dimensional Boolean cube, let $0<\varepsilon\le 1/2$, and let $M$ be a positive integer. For every output and cost pair in the support of the Kushilevitz–Mansour program run with target $f$, accuracy parameter $\varepsilon$, and parameter $M$, the number $q$ of membership queries satisfies $q\le 2^{40}(n+1)^2(M+1)^8/\varepsilon^{10}$.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ is a Boolean function from the $n$-cube to signs
the output and cost pair lies in the support of the program's run
